title: Positive-upper-density subsets of a finite-measure open cover are Hⁿ-σ-finite, and ν-null ones are Hⁿ-null (Simon 6, proof of 8.1, (1) and (6))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ^P; for an arbitrary E ⊆ ℝ^P, ν(E) denotes its outer measure. Let (W_q)_{q∈ℕ} be open subsets of ℝ^P with ν(W_q) < ∞ for every q. Let S ⊆ ⋃_q W_q be an arbitrary, not necessarily measurable, set such that the upper density Θ*ⁿ(ν, x) = limsup_{r↓0} ν(B̄_r(x))/(ω_n rⁿ) (dimensionalUpperDensity ν n univ x) is > 0 for every x ∈ S. Write Hⁿ = μHE[n] for the n-dimensional Hausdorff outer measure on ℝ^P. Then (i) there are sets C_i ⊆ ℝ^P (i ∈ ℕ) with S ⊆ ⋃_i C_i and Hⁿ(C_i) < ∞ for every i; and (ii) if ν(S) = 0, then Hⁿ(S) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (W : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (S : Set (Eucl P)), (∀ q, IsOpen (W q)) → (∀ q, ν (W q) < ∞) → S ⊆ ⋃ q, W q → (∀ x ∈ S, 0 < dimensionalUpperDensity ν.toOuterMeasure (n : ℝ) univ x) → (∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), S ⊆ ⋃ i, C i ∧ ∀ i, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (C i) < ∞) ∧ (ν S = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) S = 0)
